description: This file is a shell script for testing the disabling of SSH in Git operations, including setting up repositories, testing protocol URLs, and validating behavior with special character cases.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up the SSH wrapper for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified message.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Tests different protocol URLs against expected protocols.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure.
